topics.hook_summary: I get all these haters when I say that eventually Ethereum is going to flip Bitcoin, and eventually Bitcoin maxis are going to look for Kaspa and move over to Kaspa.
$3.33 is going to be the start. If crypto gets to 100 trillion, I can't imagine Kaspa being under a hundred billion in market cap, which will put us well above $3.
A lot of people are in denial. They think that their job is safe, but it really isn't. It's capitalism, not moneyism.
Kaspa sells speed to normies and war-grade money to cypherpunks. I approve of that. Fair launch, proof of work, no premine, no insider allocation, no pre-sales.
If they're gonna want to start to ban AI, that's going to cause a surge with TAO, with Bittensor and all the subnets, because then you have decentralized AI.

The reason the flip matters: 'There are thousands of tokens that are launched and they can't really overcome the network effect of Bitcoin.' Cut before the 'inferior technology' aside.
'I think that's the push' (head of the payoff sentence; split here only to drop 4.6s of dead air at 2148.7-2153.3).

Payoff: '...that a lot of the Bitcoin maxis are going to need, having Ethereum, proof of stake, flip Bitcoin. And they're going to see Kaspa, the superior in every way, and warm up to Kaspa.' Ends on 'Kaspa.'
